This document replicates the primary treatment effect models from `05_results_effects.Rmd` using [`cleanresults`](https://github.com/shayemcd/clean-results). It showcases three table presentation styles:

1. **`stargazer`**: Stacked robust standard errors underneath point estimates, asterisks for significance, explicit reference categories (`—`), and compact columns.
2. **`apa`**: Standard APA 7th edition layout with separate columns for unstandardized estimate ($b$), 95% Confidence Interval ($[LL, UL]$), and exact $p$-value.
3. **`compact`**: Space-efficient inline layout ($b^* [95\%\text{ CI}]$) placing estimate, significance stars, and confidence bounds in a single cell per outcome.

# Set Up

```{r packages & wd, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
options(scipen=1, digits=3)

local({
  if (!file.exists(".here") && !file.exists("../.here")) {
    p <- tryCatch(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path, error = function(e) "")
    if (nzchar(p)) setwd(dirname(p))
  }
  here::i_am("scripts/05_results_effects_cleanresults.Rmd")
})

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
setwd(here::here())

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  comment = NA
)

# Source project setup
source(here::here("R", "setup.R"))

# Source cleanresults functions
invisible(lapply(list.files(here::here("R", "cleanresults"), pattern = "[.]R$", full.names = TRUE), source))
```

```{r baseline mapping}
# Map each post-intervention DV to its matching raw baseline measure.
# clean_regress automatically centers each baseline on the analytic sample.
baseline_map <- setNames(
  c("ER0Norm_Pre", "Sureness_Pre_1", "ER1_Pre", "ER2_Pre", "ER2020_Pre", "ER2024_Pre", "ER_Pre", "AffPol_Pre"),
  dvs_post
)

baseline_map_std <- setNames(
  c("ER0Norm_Pre", "Sureness_Pre_1", "ER1_Pre", "ER2_Pre", "ER2020_Pre", "ER2024_Pre", "ER_Pre", "AffPol_Pre"),
  dvs_post_std
)
```

# 1. Study 1: Primary Treatment Effects

Regresses post-intervention outcomes on conversational feedback condition (reference: Adversarial Dialogue) and interface type (reference: Chat), adjusting for centered baseline outcome scores. Pairwise contrasts among all three feedback conditions are computed using `clean_regress()`'s integrated contrasts argument with Holm-adjusted $p$-values.

```{r fit study 1}
res_s1 <- clean_regress(
  df_consp,
  dvs = dvs_post,
  type = "linear",
  predictors = ~ ConditionFeedback + ConditionChat,
  baseline = baseline_map,
  contrasts = "ConditionFeedback",
  dv_labels = new_labels
)
```

## 1.1 Stargazer Style (`style = "stargazer"`)

Stacked robust standard errors with significance asterisks.

```{r s1 stargazer}
cr_table(res_s1, style = "stargazer")
```

## 1.2 APA Style (`style = "apa"`)

Separate columns for estimate ($b$), 95% Confidence Interval, and exact $p$-value.

```{r s1 apa}
cr_table(res_s1, style = "apa")
```

## 1.3 Compact Style (`style = "compact"`)

Inline combined point estimate, stars, and confidence interval: $b^* [95\%\text{ CI}]$.

```{r s1 compact}
cr_table(res_s1, style = "compact")
```

## 1.4 Standalone Pairwise Contrasts Table

Contrasts table extracted directly via `cr_contrast_table()`.

```{r s1 contrasts}
cr_contrast_table(res_s1, style = "stargazer")
```

# 2. Study 2: Primary Treatment Effects

Regresses post-intervention outcomes on conversational feedback condition (reference: Cats & Dogs Control), adjusting for centered baseline values. Contrasts evaluate Belief-Tailored and Adversarial Dialogue relative to Control and to each other.

```{r fit study 2}
res_s2 <- clean_regress(
  df_consp_2,
  dvs = dvs_post,
  type = "linear",
  predictors = ~ ConditionFeedback,
  baseline = baseline_map,
  contrasts = "ConditionFeedback",
  dv_labels = new_labels
)
```

## 2.1 Stargazer Style (`style = "stargazer"`)

```{r s2 stargazer}
cr_table(res_s2, style = "stargazer")
```

## 2.2 APA Style (`style = "apa"`)

```{r s2 apa}
cr_table(res_s2, style = "apa")
```

## 2.3 Compact Style (`style = "compact"`)

```{r s2 compact}
cr_table(res_s2, style = "compact")
```

## 2.4 Standalone Pairwise Contrasts Table

```{r s2 contrasts}
cr_contrast_table(res_s2, style = "stargazer")
```

# 3. Standardized Treatment Effects

Standardized ($z$-scored) post-intervention outcomes for cross-outcome effect size comparisons.

```{r standardized models}
res_s1_std <- clean_regress(
  df_consp,
  dvs = dvs_post_std,
  type = "linear",
  predictors = ~ ConditionFeedback + ConditionChat,
  baseline = baseline_map_std,
  contrasts = "ConditionFeedback",
  dv_labels = new_labels2
)

res_s2_std <- clean_regress(
  df_consp_2,
  dvs = dvs_post_std,
  type = "linear",
  predictors = ~ ConditionFeedback,
  baseline = baseline_map_std,
  contrasts = "ConditionFeedback",
  dv_labels = new_labels2
)
```

## 3.1 Study 1: Standardized Outcomes (Compact)

```{r s1 std compact}
cr_table(res_s1_std, style = "compact")
```

## 3.2 Study 2: Standardized Outcomes (Compact)

```{r s2 std compact}
cr_table(res_s2_std, style = "compact")
```

# 4. Intention-to-Treat (ITT) Models

Missing post-intervention scores are imputed by carrying baseline scores forward.

```{r itt models}
baseline_map_itt <- setNames(
  c("ER0Norm_Pre", "Sureness_Pre_1", "ER1_Pre", "ER2_Pre", "ER2020_Pre", "ER2024_Pre", "ER_Pre", "AffPol_Pre"),
  dvs_post_itt
)

res_s1_itt <- clean_regress(
  df_consp,
  dvs = dvs_post_itt,
  type = "linear",
  predictors = ~ ConditionFeedback + ConditionChat,
  baseline = baseline_map_itt,
  contrasts = "ConditionFeedback",
  dv_labels = new_labels_itt
)

res_s2_itt <- clean_regress(
  df_consp_2,
  dvs = dvs_post_itt,
  type = "linear",
  predictors = ~ ConditionFeedback,
  baseline = baseline_map_itt,
  contrasts = "ConditionFeedback",
  dv_labels = new_labels_itt
)
```

## 4.1 Study 1: ITT (Stargazer Style)

```{r s1 itt stargazer}
cr_table(res_s1_itt, style = "stargazer")
```

## 4.2 Study 2: ITT (Stargazer Style)

```{r s2 itt stargazer}
cr_table(res_s2_itt, style = "stargazer")
```

# 5. Downstream Voting Likelihood (Study 2)

Evaluates whether conversational AI interventions influenced participants' self-reported likelihood of voting in the 2024 general election (0-100 scale) or candidate preference lean.

```{r voting models}
df_vote_s2 <- df_both %>% filter(Study == 2)

res_vote <- clean_regress(
  df_vote_s2,
  dvs = c(Vote_Post_1 = "linear"),
  predictors = ~ ConditionFeedback,
  baseline = c(Vote_Post_1 = "Vote_Pre_1"),
  contrasts = "ConditionFeedback",
  dv_labels = c(Vote_Post_1 = "2024 Voting Likelihood (0-100)")
)

res_lean <- clean_regress(
  df_both,
  dvs = c(lean_bidentrump_Post_4 = "linear"),
  predictors = ~ ConditionFeedback,
  contrasts = "ConditionFeedback",
  dv_labels = c(lean_bidentrump_Post_4 = "Vote Lean (Harris vs. Trump)")
)
```

## 5.1 Voting Likelihood (APA Style)

```{r vote apa}
cr_table(res_vote, style = "apa")
```

## 5.2 Voting Likelihood (Stargazer Style)

```{r vote stargazer}
cr_table(res_vote, style = "stargazer")
```

## 5.3 Candidate Preference Lean (Stargazer Style)

```{r lean stargazer}
cr_table(res_lean, style = "stargazer")
```

# 6. Dynamic Manuscript Inline Reporting

`cleanresults` provides `cr_inline()` to dynamically embed model estimates, standard errors, confidence intervals, and $p$-values directly into text without manual transcription.

### Example Inline Outputs:

- **Study 1 Belief-Tailored effect on 2020 Denialism**:
  `r cr_inline(res_s1, dv = "ER0Norm_Post", variable = "ConditionFeedback", level = "Belief tailored")`
- **Study 1 Belief-Tailored effect on Claim Certainty**:
  `r cr_inline(res_s1, dv = "Sureness_Post_1", variable = "ConditionFeedback", level = "Belief tailored")`
- **Study 2 Belief-Tailored effect vs. Control on 2020 Denialism**:
  `r cr_inline(res_s2, dv = "ER0Norm_Post", variable = "ConditionFeedback", level = "Belief tailored")`
- **Study 2 Belief-Tailored effect vs. Control on Claim Certainty**:
  `r cr_inline(res_s2, dv = "Sureness_Post_1", variable = "ConditionFeedback", level = "Belief tailored")`
